findings.status: claims_records.status + STATUSES in claimsConstants. Existing moStatus modal.
findings.history: claims_history via appendHistory. Already writes last_activity_at.
findings.last_activity_at: column exists. Map lastActivityAt. Current table column עדכון shows updatedAt (any save), not last treatment.
findings.nextDate: already in claim row_data (fc_nextDate / treat tab תאריך יעד). Not shown on main list.
findings.reminders: claims_reminders action=note (staff reminders) and action=send_email (mail followup Dry Run). saveReminder currently INSERT-only.
findings.alerts: claims_notifications + dashboard תזכורות from note reminders.
findings.close: closeClaim + moClose exists. Sets הסתיים/שולם/נדחה. Not archive.
findings.archive: no archived flag yet. Will use row_data.archived — no new table.
findings.delete: RLS allows delete with ON DELETE CASCADE. No UI. Will soft-delete via row_data.deletedAt only — no Hard Delete.
findings.notCreating: no parallel status, reminder, history, or archive tables
